aplikacja.odpowiedz: The browser version works on your phone now. iOS and Android apps, with offline map downloads, are in preparation.

poza_europa.odpowiedz: Yes. The planner is global, the interface is available in several languages, and distances and times are calculated using local transport.

przeciazenie.odpowiedz: On the contrary – when the plan becomes unrealistic, it tells you directly and suggests what to move. You can set your own limit, for example, a maximum of four hours a day.
przeciazenie.pytanie: Will the agent not cram too much into one day?

zrodla.odpowiedz: From open databases of attractions, traveler reviews, and boards published by users. Opening hours and visiting times are verified before being shown in the feed.
zrodla.pytanie: Where do the places come from?

hero.opis: Search for attractions and add them to your trip board — "definitely", "maybe", "no". The agent creates a daily plan with realistic times and travel durations, and provides a ready-to-use GPX file for your watch or navigation device.
hero.tytul: Collect places. The agent will arrange the rest.
hero.zapewnienia: No card required · plan ready in minutes · also works offline in the field

mapy.opis: Organic Maps, Komoot, Gaia, Locus. The file opens without conversion.

nawigacja.opis: Built-in point-to-point guidance, with times from the plan. The map downloads before departure and works offline.

zegarek.opis: Garmin, Suunto, Coros, Wahoo – standard GPX with waypoints and track.

01.opis: City, dates, and trip vibe. The agent immediately suggests initial places, including those you hadn't considered.
01.tytul: Tell us where and with whom

02.opis: An attractions feed with photos, visiting times, and opening hours. One click adds a place to your board.

03.opis: The board has three buckets: definite, maybe, no. Rejected items don't disappear – you can always restore them.

04.opis: A daily plan with times, order, and travel duration. Finally, a GPX file for your watch or navigation.
